SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(revenue_delta_minor AS DECIMAL(65, 0))), 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(cost_delta_minor AS DECIMAL(65, 0))), 0) AS cost FROM mk_dashboard_projection_delta WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND occurred_at >= #{from} AND occurred_at < #{to}

SELECT
SUBSTRING(occurred_at, 1, 13) SUBSTRING(occurred_at, 1, 10) AS bucketValue, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(revenue_delta_minor AS DECIMAL(65, 0))), 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(cost_delta_minor AS DECIMAL(65, 0))), 0) AS cost, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fact_type = 'CONVERSION' THEN count_delta ELSE 0 END), 0) AS conversions FROM mk_dashboard_projection_delta WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND occurred_at >= #{from} AND occurred_at < #{to} GROUP BY bucketValue ORDER BY bucketValue
